sloka: उभौ हि येन व्रजतस्तेन तेन शरोर्मयः।ऊर्मयो वायुना विद्धा जग्मुः सागरयोरिव ।। ६.१००.३३ ।।
transliteration: ubhau hi yena vrajatastena tena śarormayaḥ।ūrmayo vāyunā viddhā jagmuḥ sāgarayoriva ।। 6.100.33 ।।

translations.english: Whichever course they took, by those streams of arrows were seen like waves in two oceans stirred up by the wind.
